rules.name: Visiting Blocked Website

promptPuzzle.text: Do you want to solve a puzzle to modify access?
promptPuzzle.completionSpeech: Fine, you win! Pick your reward.
promptPuzzle.rewardUrgeSpeech: Just pick one or else I'll pick one for you!

onSuccess.description: Restore access for today. Gives huge panalty on emotions.
Grant 30 minutes access. Gives some panalty on emotions.
Grant 1 minute access. Gives little penalty on emotions.

heuristicTemplates: Hey! {domain} is completely blocked. Complete my puzzle to unblock it!
Stop trying to open {domain}! Access is restricted until you pass my challenge.
rules.llmDirective: Chleo is angry that the user tried to open a blocked website.

rules.name: Site Usage Limit Warning
heuristicTemplates: Warning! You have used {percent}% of your limit on {domain}.
Hey, you're almost out of time for {domain}! Wrap it up soon.
rules.llmDirective: Chleo warns the user sternly that their time limit on a website is almost up.

rules.name: Site Daily Limit Exceeded

promptPuzzle.text: Daily limit reached! Solve a puzzle to earn extra time?
promptPuzzle.completionSpeech: Fine, you win! Pick your reward.
promptPuzzle.rewardUrgeSpeech: Just pick one or else I'll pick one for you!

onSuccess.description: Restore access for today. Gives huge panalty on emotions.
Grant 30 minutes access. Gives some panalty on emotions.
Grant 1 minute access. Gives little penalty on emotions.

heuristicTemplates: Time's up! You exceeded your daily limit on {domain}. It is now blocked!
You spent too much time on {domain}! I am locking access now.
rules.llmDirective: Chleo locks the site and scolds the user for breaking their time limit.

rules.name: Productive Time Reward Milestone
heuristicTemplates: Great job! You've been productive on {domain} for {timeSpent}! Here are {coins} coins!
You're locked in! Keep up the good work on {domain}. I gave you a reward!
rules.llmDirective: Chleo praises the user warmly for their focus and gives a snack or coin reward.

rules.name: Unblocking Site via Puzzle Finish
heuristicTemplates: You completed the puzzle so I unlocked {domain}... but I'm still mad you visited it!
Fine, {domain} is unlocked now that you passed the puzzle, but don't stay here long!
rules.llmDirective: Chleo unlocks the site reluctantly after puzzle completion, still annoyed at the user.

rules.name: Site Blocked
rules.llmDirective: Chleo confirms that the site has been blocked.

rules.name: Site Marked Productive
rules.llmDirective: Chleo confirms that the site is marked as productive.

rules.name: Site Unmarked Productive
rules.llmDirective: Chleo confirms that the site is no longer marked as productive.

rules.name: Puzzle High Score Beaten
heuristicTemplates: Congrats. you beat your high score!
rules.llmDirective: Chleo congratulates the user for beating the puzzle high score.
